title: Typed journey-checkpoint events named domain.surface.action
context: application-spa-REQ-016 requires named events. Free-text names drift with refactors and kill dashboard continuity; the scheme needs one recorded answer inside the SPA.
decision: Telemetry events are declared in a typed registry and named domain.surface.action in lower camel segments (for example auth.signIn.succeeded, orders.list.filtered). Error-boundary reports and the two performance marks (firstPaint, timeToInteractive) use reserved names in the same registry. Emitting an unregistered event name is a build-time error.
consequences: Dashboards and alerts survive refactors because names are contracts. New journeys pay one registry entry per checkpoint, which doubles as the checkpoint inventory application-spa-REQ-008 walks.
